changes: Liquid Glass redesign of Lumen (T-020): ambient liturgical light, content and control glass, live blur on Android 12+ and refraction lens on Android 13+ (untested on device).
New selectable identity Cristal (transparent refracting glass) next to Lumen and Sanctuary.
Single header on every screen (same art height and title line); new public-domain paintings for Saints, First steps and the Gospel of John card.
Accent colour follows the liturgical colour of the day with the default Liturgical Dynamic tint.
Marian devotions: 25 new (T-018) and literal, sourced quotations for the Guadalupe, Fatima and Miraculous Medal promises.
known_limitations: Full unit-test suite not run here (T-020 reports 477/483; the 6 failures are RecoverySheetsScreenshotTest, which already failed before the redesign).
Live blur, AGSL lens, haptics and scroll performance not verified on a device.
